rate_rule: q=Pn/(An+Pn); gain=ema(q^2, decay 0.9); m=m_k3p+(1-m_k3p)*gain; gain starts at 0
mix_rule: K3P handover of the applied critic LR; a larger penalty share raises LR and therefore releases the anchor
horizon_note: K3P LR schedule and noise still read the declared horizon; the share term does not. Intermediate ablation.
why: pb1 fight_ema stayed near 0.02 on the quiet floor and failed pre-hold checks 1280-1350; squaring the penalty share suppresses that floor and keeps the post-shift reopen
decomposition: g_tot = g_adv + coeff * g_pen; g_pen = d(penalty)/d(critic) via autograd.grad, not written into .grad; one Adam step per role
